title: Two Sum
description:
Given an array of $n$ integers and a target value $t$, find two distinct indices $i$ and $j$ ($1$-indexed) such that $a_i + a_j = t$.

It is guaranteed that exactly one solution exists.
inputFormat:
The first line contains two integers $n$ and $t$ ($2 \leq n \leq 10^5$, $-2 \cdot 10^9 \leq t \leq 2 \cdot 10^9$) — the size of the array and the target sum.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print two space-separated integers $i$ and $j$ ($1 \leq i < j \leq n$) — the 1-indexed positions of the two elements that sum to $t$.
constraints:
$2 \leq n \leq 10^5$
$-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$
$-2 \cdot 10^9 \leq t \leq 2 \cdot 10^9$
Exactly one valid pair exists.
